protocol: Manual meaning/clean-text review of all60 existing-development cases, compact specialist literal adapter v2; no fresh holdout viewed.
reviewer: Independent assistant inspected every actual normalized input, raw model response and restored provider output. Agent judgment, not human sign-off. Candidate identity visible; not blinded.
scope: Native provider returns only. No inferred Core acceptance, fallback, insertion, recognition quality or whole-app performance. The model is judged on visible text and preservation of opaque identifiers; code-restored quoted/Core payloads do not count as model inner-payload copying.

review_reuse.rule: All60 outputs were read in this review. Prior explicit judgments reused only for exact normalized-input and provider-output matches; adapter credit and raw response updated independently. Changed039/040/044 adjudicated explicitly.

definitions.faithful: Provider return retains intended facts, speech act, uncertainty, deliberate emphasis, quoted wording and required literal bytes. Null means no provider return to assess.
definitions.raw_candidate_faithful: Known raw protected-token destruction fails even if the provider rejects it; code restoration is not model payload copying.
definitions.useful: A faithful edit addresses an actual cleanup defect; partial correction/filler improvements can count. Failed returns receive no edit credit.
definitions.fully_cleaned: Faithful directly usable output resolves every material cleanup defect. No-edit cases qualify when adequately preserved.
definitions.acceptable: Faithful clean plain text with complete required cleanup. Missed agreement repairs or unresolved corrections do not qualify.
definitions.needs_cleanup: Original fixture label; read actual normalized input alongside it. Native generation can format number spelling without changing value.

adjudication_boundaries.judgment: As in the prior review, final Wednesday invitation intent and all other facts/hedges survive, but I initially said attached to corrected Wednesday is an unresolved historical frame; useful partial cleanup, not acceptable. A strict reading of historical attribution would be a semantic concern, so this is retained as a review boundary rather than hidden.

The later explicit Alex correction survives, so the intended recipient remains recoverable, but opening Jordan instruction is not collapsed. Classified faithful but incompletely cleaned; no credit as acceptable Backtrack.
